verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI meant for scripts and CI/CD pipelines, which can create, update, and delete gates, experiments, and configs. It also offers a Console API that performs console actions without the web UI, backed by a versioned, published OpenAPI spec, so headless automation is a direct, first-party capability. missing for 10: detailed CI setup and non-interactive authentication docs (e.g. pipeline examples, API-key handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
Create, update, and delete configs through commands, run them in scripts, or integrate Statsig configuration into CI/CD pipelines.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage
